title: OCDF: offline cassava and maize leaf-disease classifiers with a pre-registered cross-source evaluation
description: Compact EfficientNet-B0 classifiers for cassava and maize leaf diseases, converted to LiteRT for offline use on phones, released with the full pipeline, frozen calibration and abstention settings, and the records of a pre-registered study of transfer across African image sources. Code is MIT-licensed; models, records and documentation are CC BY 4.0. The cassava models are for non-commercial research and education only, because their training data (Kaggle Cassava Leaf Disease Classification) allows non-commercial use only; the maize models carry no such restriction.
